name: BlazeMeter
description_en:
BlazeMeter provides cloud testing across performance, APIs, functional workflows, monitoring and related test-data services. Its current site also promotes autonomous test creation. This profile focuses on the documented performance-testing path, where scripts, load configuration and pass/fail criteria remain concrete evaluation inputs.

A proposed trial should first establish that a script and its test data behave correctly at low scale, then define the metrics that make a load run meaningful. Debug output, a completed test and an application performance pass are different results. No script, traffic, credential, account or paid test was executed.
description_zh:
BlazeMeter 提供性能、API、功能流程、监控及相关测试数据云服务，当前网站也推广自主测试创建。本文聚焦有文档依据的性能测试路径，其中脚本、负载配置及通过／失败标准仍是具体评估输入。

拟定试用应先在小规模确认脚本和测试数据行为，再定义令负载结果有意义的指标。调试输出、测试完成和应用性能通过是不同结果。本次未执行脚本、流量、凭据、账户或付费测试。

sections.title_en: Upload a script together with its execution assumptions
sections.title_zh: 脚本需连同执行假设一起配置
sections.en: The creation guide describes Taurus-backed engines and paths for JMeter JMX, Taurus YAML and other supported scripts. Extra files can be distributed to the engines. If automatic script recognition fails, an explicit YAML configuration can help identify the executor. Confirm dependencies, relative files, target environment and load settings rather than assuming a script that runs locally reproduces the same test in the cloud.
sections.zh: 创建指南介绍基于 Taurus 的引擎，以及 JMeter JMX、Taurus YAML 和其他脚本路径，附加文件可分发到引擎。自动识别失败时可用明确 YAML 配置识别执行器。应核对依赖、相对文件、目标环境及负载设置，不能假定本地脚本在云端自然复现相同测试。

sections.title_en: Debug mode does not produce a performance pass
sections.title_zh: 调试模式不产生性能通过结论
sections.en: Debug creates a logical test copy with ten threads, ending at five minutes or one hundred iterations, whichever comes first. The guide says it does not charge test credits/VUH, retains data for thirty days and does not enforce or display pass/fail status. It is useful for inspecting configuration and trace artifacts before a larger run. A successful debug session therefore does not show that a release met its performance thresholds.
sections.zh: 调试创建逻辑测试副本，使用十线程，在五分钟或一百次迭代中先到者结束。指南称不收测试信用／VUH，数据保留三十天，且不执行或显示通过／失败状态。它适合大规模运行前检查配置及 trace 产物，因此调试成功不证明发布满足性能阈值。

sections.title_en: Failure rules must be enabled and scoped
sections.title_zh: 失败规则需要启用并限定范围
sections.en: Failure criteria select labels, metrics, comparison operators and thresholds. Only the first one hundred rules count if the limit is exceeded. A sliding window evaluates a sixty-second period every ten seconds; early stop is available with that option. Ramp-up exclusions are another explicit choice. Review rule ordering and evaluation windows against the intended objective instead of treating any completed run as a pass.
sections.zh: 失败标准选择标签、指标、比较符及阈值。超限时只计算前一百条规则。滑动窗口每十秒评估六十秒区间，提前停止与该选项配合；是否排除爬升期也需明确选择。应按目标检查规则顺序及评估窗口，不能把运行完成当作通过。

sections.title_en: A baseline comparison needs an existing reference
sections.title_zh: 基线比较需要已有参考
sections.en: The criteria guide supports relative thresholds and tolerated offsets against a selected baseline. Taurus baseline-based failures require an already defined BlazeMeter test and a baseline established there; it cannot create the reference during that run. Choose a representative environment and version, retain the comparison context and investigate changes in load or test data before attributing a slowdown to application code.
sections.zh: 标准指南支持相对所选基线的阈值及容许偏移。Taurus 基线失败比较要求已有 BlazeMeter 测试并事先建立基线，不能在该次运行中创建参考。应选择有代表性的环境／版本，保留比较上下文，并在将变慢归因应用代码前检查负载及测试数据变化。

sections.title_en: Splitting CSV data changes header handling
sections.title_zh: 拆分 CSV 会改变表头处理
sections.en: The CSV guide offers a unique subset per engine so concurrent engines need not reuse the same user row. It explicitly says the split does not preserve the header across engines and recommends defining variable names in CSV Data Set Config. Separate per-engine files are another path. Validate row allocation with synthetic identifiers first; input uniqueness does not by itself guarantee application cleanup or avoid repeated writes on later runs.
sections.zh: CSV 指南可为各引擎分配唯一子集，避免并发引擎复用同一用户行。它明确说明拆分不保留各引擎表头，建议在 CSV Data Set Config 定义变量名，也可使用各引擎独立文件。应先用虚构标识验证分配；输入唯一不自动保证应用清理，也不避免后续运行重复写入。

sections.title_en: Masking depends on enabled secret selection
sections.title_zh: 掩码依赖启用的 secret 选择
sections.en: The secrets guide supports a default or external vault and masks selected enabled values in logs/reports. JMeter references are detected during upload; other executors need manual enabling. Up to fifty secrets may be used per test, and changing the source clears earlier selections. Review least-privilege test credentials and artifact handling. The page’s conflicting production/non-production advice is not treated as permission to use live credentials; no secret was entered.
sections.zh: secret 指南支持默认或外部保险库，并在日志／报告中掩码选定启用的值。JMeter 引用在上传时检测，其他执行器需手动启用。每测试最多五十个 secret，切换来源会清除已有选择。应检查最小权限测试凭据及产物处理；页面矛盾的生产／非生产建议不作为使用线上凭据授权，本次未输入 secret。

sections.title_en: Performance and API monitoring have separate fee dimensions
sections.title_zh: 性能与 API 监控有不同计费维度
sections.en: Displayed Performance Basic costs $1,188 annually or $149 monthly, with one thousand concurrent users and a one-hour maximum duration. Pro uses a different concurrency/VUH allowance. The API section separately lists request-based plans, such as Small at $79/month for 250,000 requests. These are product-specific allowances, not one all-inclusive subscription. Verify selected term, limits, currency, taxes and extra services before making a workload estimate.
sections.zh: 显示的 Performance Basic 为年付 $1,188 或月付 $149，含一千并发用户及最长一小时，Pro 采用不同并发／VUH 额度。API 部分另列请求方案，如 Small 每月 $79／二十五万请求。这是各产品额度，不是全包套餐。估算负载前需核所选账期、限额、币种、税及额外服务。
